description: InaRISK is the disaster risk portal of the Indonesian National Disaster Management Agency. Its layer services show hazard, vulnerability, capacity and risk layers for floods, flash floods, extreme weather, extreme waves and coastal abrasion, earthquakes, forest and land fires, droughts, volcanic eruptions, landslides, tsunamis, liquefaction, multi-hazard and COVID-19, over satellite, terrain or road base maps. The menu links a risk index, Sendai Framework monitoring, resilience pages, methodology and a disclaimer, GIS services through a GeoServer, map and web GIS galleries, map downloads, reporting and assessment dashboards, and downloads of the Indonesian disaster risk index (IRBI 2025), the disaster risk atlas (RBI 2022) and the national disaster management master plan 2015 to 2045 with a user guide. Access is free and public; the terms are in the disclaimer and no licence is named on the page read. Caveats: the map loads by script and the portal is mainly in Indonesian, with an English option. Coverage is Indonesia. It supports hazard exposure and multi-hazard risk analysis for roads, settlements and other infrastructure, and emergency response planning; related records are the Mexico Atlas Nacional de Riesgos and the NIED bosaiXview maps.
